      "changes": "Input schematic imported with embedded source symbols and explicit TI model pin assignments. Terminal assemblies and virtual sources/output loads form evenly spaced columns spanning the lower circuit. All virtual output loads are 100 ohms. Virtual components have no Footprint and use 2.54 mm source leads with load leads extended to matching rail-label and official triangular-GND levels; completed electrical values and series resistance are recorded in simulation provenance.
